name: s81sl_capc2-s81capc2-COMMIT
purpose: S81.STA.PAR.1 release CAPC cluster: closed rt/tr + new ED24/LD16 calendar leaves, PINPIPE 1 faces; bench vs closed 3-child RTL

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_capc2 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_HARD_CHILDREN --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay_rf.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_cap_ed.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_cap_ld.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_cap.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_cap_p1.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_capc2.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_capc2 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ed/views/ot_s81sl_cap_ed --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ld/views/ot_s81sl_cap_ld --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_rt/views/ot_s81sl_cap_rt --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_tr/views/ot_s81sl_cap_tr > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: LEAD2-S81/CAPC2 10-19 S81.STA.PAR.1: the CAPC cluster gains the two TOK.DS.BENCH.1 calendar leaves as hard children -- u_ed ot_s81sl_cap_ed (D 24, E tree word -> n6) and u_ld3 ot_s81sl_cap_ld (D 16, W lane 3 -> u_tw) -- in a non-parameterised top ot_s81sl_capc2 = ot_s81sl_cap_p1 #(PINPIPE 1, EDLY 24, WL3DLY 16) (hard views carry no parameters). Same closed rt/tr child views and PINPIPE 1 face registers as CLOSED 267b (s81sl_capc_p1_die_slew); trees moved up 86.4 so the rt-to-tree seam (142.56) holds ED under u_te and LD under u_tw on the 43.2 lattice with >= 20 um channels (56.16 below, 38.88 above); outline 329.184 x 411.48 (closed-children stack + 20 um core channels; fill 38 %).
